Usage

When to use. Dock references beside a response so people can trace every claim to its source. Each item surfaces the source icon, title, and a short glimpse of the referenced content — file references show author and date; web references show the site and URL.

Do

  • Group primary results, then a “Related results” section.
  • Truncate long titles/URLs to one line; clamp snippets to two.
  • Keep the source icon/favicon to aid recognition.
  • Let the whole item be the click target to open the source.

Don't

  • Mix unrelated content into the references list.
  • Hide the dismiss control — the panel is dismissible.
  • Show more than a two-line snippet per item.
  • Drop the author/date or URL that establishes provenance.
